postal_system.assignment_rule: POST Luxembourg publishes the current assignment reference. CACLR is the national locality, street, building-number and postcode reference, but its current file model has no coordinates and is not a POST postcode-boundary release.
postal_system.endpoint_rule: PackUp points, Point POST, PO boxes, organizations, bulk receivers, routes and other endpoints remain non-areal unless an independent authoritative source explicitly supplies valid postcode geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: ACT BD-Adresses supplies CC0 georeferenced address points derived from CACLR. The points may be manually positioned or based on parcel/building centroids and do not independently define a postal surface.
postal_system.postal_surface_rule: Only a current rights-cleared source Polygon/MultiPolygon, or an expressly authorized reproducible derivation from a complete current postal membership denominator, may become a postcode surface. Point buffers, hulls, Voronoi cells, raster cells, buildings, parcels and administrative boundaries are prohibited proxies.
postal_system.building_rule: A building is address context only through a stable explicit source relation or reviewed crosswalk; containment and proximity remain candidates and never create postcode geometry.
postal_system.territory_rule: Every feature retains Luxembourg identity and the LU partition; neighbouring Belgium, France and Germany geometry is never absorbed by interpolation.

quality_gates.pass: A current complete POST assignment denominator and explicit AGID processing, public serving and redistribution rights are pinned by version, date, byte length and SHA-256.
Every promoted Polygon/MultiPolygon has authoritative postcode meaning, valid topology, declared code-class coverage and reproducible lineage.
CACLR/BD-Adresses points and PackUp, Point POST, PO-box, organization and route records remain non-areal and are never buffered or tessellated.
Administrative, parcel and building geometry stays context-only and an exact building relation requires an explicit source link.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, customer, credential, private-unit occupant or land-right record is published.
Synthetic fixtures test behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts, authority separation and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete rights-cleared POST Luxembourg postcode assignment denominator, code-class exceptions and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real LU API/app so a normalized L-NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. POST/CACLR tables, BD-Adresses points, PackUp or Point POST endpoints, PO boxes, organizations, routes, administrative boundaries, parcels, buildings, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
